title.en: Energy Level Diagram of Hydrogen Atom
title.hi: हाइड्रोजन परमाणु का ऊर्जा स्तर आरेख

description.en: Diagram showing the various energy levels and spectral series (Lyman, Balmer, Paschen) of the Hydrogen atom.
description.hi: हाइड्रोजन परमाणु के विभिन्न ऊर्जा स्तरों और वर्णक्रमीय श्रेणियों (लाइमन, बामर, पाश्चन) को दर्शाने वाला आरेख।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 450" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g transform="translate(50, 400)">
    <!-- Energy Levels (n=1 to n=5 and infinity) -->
    
    <!-- n=1 Ground State -->
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="250" y2="0" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="260" y="5" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">n=1</text>
    <text x="-40" y="5" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">-13.6 eV</text>

    <!-- n=2 -->
    <line x1="0" y1="-200" x2="250" y2="-200" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="260" y="-195" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">n=2</text>
    <text x="-40" y="-195" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">-3.40 eV</text>

    <!-- n=3 -->
    <line x1="0" y1="-275" x2="250" y2="-275" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="260" y="-270" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">n=3</text>
    <text x="-40" y="-270" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">-1.51 eV</text>

    <!-- n=4 -->
    <line x1="0" y1="-310" x2="250" y2="-310" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="260" y="-305" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">n=4</text>
    <text x="-40" y="-305" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">-0.85 eV</text>

    <!-- n=5 -->
    <line x1="0" y1="-330" x2="250" y2="-330" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="260" y="-325" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">n=5</text>
    <text x="-40" y="-325" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">-0.54 eV</text>

    <!-- Infinity -->
    <line x1="0" y1="-360" x2="250" y2="-360" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <text x="260" y="-355" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">n=∞</text>
    <text x="-40" y="-355" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">0 eV</text>

    <!-- Lyman Series (to n=1) -->
    <line x1="40" y1="-200" x2="40" y2="0" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <line x1="60" y1="-275" x2="60" y2="0" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <line x1="80" y1="-310" x2="80" y2="0" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="30" y="20" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#8b5cf6">Lyman (UV)</text>

    <!-- Balmer Series (to n=2) -->
    <line x1="130" y1="-275" x2="130" y2="-200" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <line x1="150" y1="-310" x2="150" y2="-200" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <line x1="170" y1="-330" x2="170" y2="-200" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="130" y="-180" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#3b82f6">Balmer (Visible)</text>

    <!-- Paschen Series (to n=3) -->
    <line x1="210" y1="-310" x2="210" y2="-275" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <line x1="230" y1="-330" x2="230" y2="-275" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="210" y="-255" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#ef4444">Paschen (IR)</text>
  </g>
</svg>
